snippet.title: BALL x PIT | Available October 15 | Wishlist and Demo NOW
snippet.description:
BALL x PIT is coming to Steam, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch on October 15 plus Nintendo Switch 2 soon after in Fall 2025. 🥎

Wishlist and play the demo now: https://www.ballxpit.com/

BALL x PIT is a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite. Batter hordes of enemies with ricocheting balls and gather the riches of the pit to expand your homestead, generate resources and recruit unique heroes.

Visit our website for more info: https://www.devolverdigital.com/

Subscribe for more: https://devolver.link/youtube

Follow Devolver Digital
